main_text.p: summum rectè colis.] Huius sententiæ priorem partem, suæ in Reges usurpatę potestati damnosam fore præuidens Romana Curia, illud in margine annotandum mandauit, [{m} inter sæculares puras duntaxat:] sed hanc Glossam Textum corrumpere, ex sequentibus apparet; cum sententia 21. eiusdem Tractatus asserat idem author, Imperatoriam potestatem Maiestate esse similem Deo, cùm non habeat in terris se quicquam excelsius. Quod bene animaduertentes Quiroga Archiepiscopus Toletan°, reliquique Inquisitores Hispanici in suo{n} Indice Expurgatorio, illa posteriora verba deleri iubent, licèt in ipso originali Greco,Index Expurgatorius Rom. fol. 200.& 903.Pag.18. & in omnibus quas vidi tum trāslatio-nibus,tum editionibus integrè legātur; nec non in o Serm.1. Tom.5. Biblio.Sanctæ{o}Melissis Antonij Abbatis, & {p}Maximi locis communibus: quos li-bellos, propterea auguror in postrema editione Parisiensi Bibliothecæ Sacto-rum Patrum una litura expungi. Sed dabimus illa deleri, supererunt tamen apud eundem Agapetum, quæ nõ minùs nostram causam stabiliant, aduersa-riorum vulnerent: imò iugulent sen-p Serm.9. de Magi-strat.ibidē.tentia

page.notes: The printed text continues below the visible part; the last line given is the last one visible. The marginal note at mark m is set in italic with its page references. The name "Quiroga Archiepiscopus Toletan°" is underlined in the print and is transcribed without the underline. Degree-style sign after "Toletan" is copied as printed. The text is cut off at the top and right edge, and this part starts mid-paragraph. The mark "o" stands before "Melissis" and "p" before "Maximi" in the text. Both marks have a matching note in the left margin. "vna" was read as "una" (u/v rule). The final word "tentia" is set at the right of the last line and runs on to the next page. No page number or running head is visible on this part.
